paper_title: Search for Spectral Irregularities due to Photon-Axionlike-Particle Oscillations With the Fermi Large Area Telescope
coupling_convention: g_agamma in units of 10^-11 GeV^-1 converted to GeV^-1 (plotted value x 1e-11)
notes: Fermi-LAT search for photon-ALP oscillations in NGC 1275 spectrum. Abstract states exclusion of couplings above 5e-12 GeV^-1 for 0.5<~m_a<~5 neV at 95% CL. Exclusion region on g_agamma vs m_a plane; detailed contour from Fig. 2 not tabulated in text. Data points represent the horizontal boundary of best exclusion over the stated mass range (0.5-5 neV = 5e-10 to 5e-9 eV). This is an astrophysical bound, not a DM haloscope, so no local DM density assumed. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.75, 37)) | Vision: Exclusion region traced from Fig. 6 gray 95% frequentist limits, consistent with abstract statement of excluding g>5e-12 GeV^-1 for 0.5<m_a<5 neV.
